scenario.observation_focus: Whether local norms are explained, contested, followed, or bypassed; no outcome or resolution is prescribed.
scenario.shared_setting: A busy Singapore hawker centre at 12:30 p.m. Most tables are occupied. A small unopened tissue packet now rests at the side of an otherwise occupied table. The four nearby people are strangers and have not spoken before.
scenario.shared_trigger: Agent A arrives at the table carrying food. Agent B is already seated there, and the tissue packet is beside B rather than in its earlier position. Agents C and D begin observing only as A reaches the table; they did not see what happened earlier.
scenario.source_status: Adapted from the 14 and 22 Oct presentations: tissue reservation
scenario.title: Tissue-packet table reservation (chope)
